blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has signed Administrative Order No. 50, transferring the management of Mile-Long Property back to the Privatization and Management Office (PMO) to facilitate its disposition and maximize its value. The PMO is an attached agency of the Department of Finance (DOF) that acts as the government’s marketing and disposition arm for state-owned or non-performing assets. READ: Palace warns against cover-up in alleged ghost projects probe Located in Makati’s central business district, the 22,924-square-meter property was transferred to the Bases Conversion and Development Authority under Administrative Order No. 21, issued in 2020.
